name: DolarKaç – Exchange Rates and Gold Widget
author: dolarkac

sections.description:
DolarKaç – Exchange Rates and Gold Widget adds the free live widget from DolarKaç to your site as a shortcode, a block or a classic widget.

  • Live Turkish lira exchange rates: USD, EUR, GBP, CHF, SAR
  • Gold prices: gram, quarter, half, full and Republic gold, 22k bracelet gold, ounce, silver
  • Bitcoin and Ethereum (in TRY)
  • Long-term charts since 2010 (USD, EUR, gold, GBP, quarter gold, silver, Bitcoin)
  • Light, dark and auto themes
  • No cookies and no impact on page speed (lazy-loaded iframe, ~10 KB)
  • No API key or registration required

Shortcode examples:

[dolarkac]
[dolarkac ids="USD,EUR,GBP,GRAM,CEYREK" theme="dark" width="360"]
[dolarkac type="grafik" series="altin-fiyati" from="2015"]

Shortcode attributes:

  • type – kur (live rates, default) or grafik (long-term chart)
  • ids – comma separated, max 8: USD, EUR, GBP, CHF, SAR, GRAM, CEYREK, YARIM, TAM, CUMHURIYET, AYAR22, ONS, GUMUS, BTC, ETH
  • theme – light, dark or auto
  • width – pixels (200–1200)
  • series – for charts: dolar-kuru, euro-kuru, altin-fiyati, sterlin-kuru, ceyrek-altin-fiyati, gumus-fiyati, bitcoin-fiyati
  • from – chart start year (2010 or later)

Free use requires the visible “Kaynak: DolarKaç” (Source: DolarKaç) link under the widget to stay in place (DolarKaç terms of use).

External services

This plugin embeds content from the DolarKaç service (https://dolarkac.com) in an iframe. The plugin’s PHP code makes no remote requests.

  • What: the iframe loads https://dolarkac.com/embed (live price table) or https://dolarkac.com/embed/grafik (chart). The live table opens a WebSocket to DolarKaç to update prices.
  • When: every time a page containing the shortcode, block or widget is viewed.
  • Data sent: the visitor’s browser requests the iframe, so DolarKaç receives the visitor’s IP address, user agent and the referring page, plus the chosen assets/theme. No cookies are set by the widget.
  • Terms of use: https://dolarkac.com/kullanim-kosullari and https://dolarkac.com/gelistirici-api#kosullar
  • Privacy policy: https://dolarkac.com/gizlilik

The DolarKaç terms require a visible source link where the data is shown; the plugin therefore prints “Kaynak: DolarKaç” (Source: DolarKaç) under every embed.
sections.installation:
1. Upload and activate the plugin.
  2. Add the [dolarkac] shortcode to a post, insert the “DolarKaç” block, or add the “DolarKaç Live Rates” widget under Appearance > Widgets.
sections.faq:
Is it free?

Yes. The only condition is the visible source link.

How often are prices updated?

The live table updates in real time over WebSocket; charts use daily closing prices.

Is this investment advice?

No, prices are for information only.
